name: Insta-Grow
info: Instantly grows a crop or zombie!
flavorText: When you need your zombies and crops right now.

name: Insta-Harvest
flavorText: It'll harvest everything on the farm in the blink of an eye.

name: Insta-Plow
info: Plows all soil that needs plowing!
flavorText: Checks the entire farm for unplowed land, and instantly plows it all.

name: Concentration
flavorText: Prevents zombies from being distracted during invasions.  Used when you invade.

name: Golden Dice
flavorText: Increase the drop rate of rare items in a single fight, the effect is stackable. Used when you invade.

name: Invasion Voucher
flavorText: Use this to remove the wait time for an invasion.
